decisions.reason: Although a spring-balanced desk lamp is not central to the firm's stated push toward intelligent and sustainable building solutions, the dedicated launch, sunk design effort and ease of attributing any weak uptake to slow specification cycles make management persist for another year.

This general interior lighting luminaire sits squarely in the firm's core building-lighting business, so the visible recent introduction and broad fit with established applications make management reluctant to reverse course.

Because this pendant luminaire was presented as a flagship for the firm's direction, the strong public commitment and strategic centrality heavily favor continued backing despite any mixed early results.

The marine HMI searchlight is a more peripheral niche and less aligned with the sustainability narrative, but management is still likely to justify continuation by pointing to specialist competence, engineering investment and long marine project cycles.

This marine searchlight remains part of the firm's specialist robust-lighting portfolio, and the sunk development effort and plausible expectation of delayed project-driven demand support keeping it on the market for now.
